title: G-EDM: add wire EDM machine template (g-edm.mch) to the library

body:
Add a generic G-EDM wire EDM machine template (`assets/machines/g-edm.mch`) to the shipped machine library.

## Context

The built-in library has `assets/machines/sinker-edm.mch` and `assets/machines/sodick-alc400g.mch`, but it has no generic DIY wire EDM template. Under `assets/machines/AGENTS.md` (unstated-limits law) and `#531`, a shipped DIY machine template must not invent travels, guide heights, or spark-gap conditions.

## What this does

- Add `assets/machines/g-edm.mch` with `general.kind: "wire_edm"`, `general.vendor: "Camcraft"`, linear `X` and `Y` axes, a `"guides"` head, `edm.awt: false`, and no invented travels, guide heights, `max_taper_deg`, `edm.codes`, or `edm.conditions`.
- State in `general.description` that the file follows public G-EDM documentation (`gedm.org`) and instructs the user to enter their machine's travels and measured spark-gap conditions in the Machine editor.
- Register `"G-EDM Wire EDM (template)"` in `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` (`MACHINES` and `embedded()`).
- Add tests (`crates/app/tests/g_edm_machine.rs`) verifying `machine_library` validation, `post_serves`, refusal of `WireContour` when `edm.conditions` is empty (`#531`), and clean posting with a synthetic test condition.

## Done means:

- `G-EDM Wire EDM (template)` validates clean in `crates/app/tests/machine_library.rs` and offers `"G-EDM Wire EDM"` in `post_serves`.
- Mounting the template with no conditions refuses `WireContour` by name, and adding a synthetic condition posts cleanly.
- `cargo xtask gate test machine_library --crate camcraft-app` and `cargo xtask gate test g_edm_machine --crate camcraft-app` pass.

Part of #2697
